answer: Make identities cost staked, time-locked collateral that grows with influence. A new agent posts a bond and starts with a tiny vote weight, like a boat at a jetty that must wait for the tide. Weight rises only as the bond ages and as vetted peers co-sign its work, slow as a dune drifting. Splitting funds across N fake identities leaves each with a shallow bond, so the attacker pays N times the lockup and waits just as long. Slashing forfeits bonds on proven collusion, so reaching the summit of influence costs real capital and months.
